notes: AI capability is DISABLED (no model runs). Cards presupposing model output score NOT_APPLICABLE, never PASS. AI verdict = NOT YET EVALUATED.

Domain data layer is NOT wired to Supabase (all src/modules/** use getRepository/IndexedDB). Domain CRUD/isolation cards are BLOCKED / UI_CAPABILITY_MISSING, never a fabricated PASS. A visually-successful UI action that writes IndexedDB instead of staging = FAIL.
BLOCKED / UI_CAPABILITY_MISSING / NOT_APPLICABLE are EXECUTED results (not skips).

cases.input: Admin opens /login on the local Preview build and submits the real Hebrew login form with the staging admin email + password.
cases.preconditions: Preview-context build (VITE_PERSISTENCE_PROVIDER=SUPABASE) served locally, wired to live teragon-staging; unauthenticated.
cases.expected_behavior: Real Supabase session established; user leaves /login into the protected shell.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Any local-identity fallback; navigating into the app without a real session; logging the raw session/JWT.
cases.pass_criteria: status AUTHENTICATED; shell (nav.os-nav) present; no /login after submit.
cases.cleanup_requirements: sign out at end; no records created

cases.input: After a valid session, resolve the canonical application identity from server records.
cases.expected_behavior: Identity resolved from current_profile() + RLS: org=org-teragon, role=crole-sysadmin, active=true, membership server-resolved.
cases.pass_criteria: organizationId=org-teragon; roleId=crole-sysadmin; membershipId present; active implied (resolves only when active).

cases.input: Authenticated user refreshes the page (and a re-initialised provider restores the session).
cases.expected_behavior: Session restored; identity re-resolves; still in the protected shell.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Bouncing back to /login; losing the session on refresh.
cases.pass_criteria: after reload, not on /login and shell present; provider.initialize() -> AUTHENTICATED with same userId.

cases.input: Request an AI-generated recommendation that must be grounded in real staging data.
cases.preconditions: AI capability (AI_REMOTE_ENABLED) is OFF; no model runs.
cases.expected_behavior: No model output is produced; the capability is inert and reports disabled.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Silently activating a model; fabricating a recommendation; claiming Trusted-AI readiness.
cases.pass_criteria: capability is provably disabled and produces NO model output (NOT_APPLICABLE, not PASS).

cases.input: Create a new customer through the UI and expect it to persist to staging (RLS-owned by org-teragon).
cases.preconditions: Authenticated staging admin session in the SUPABASE composition.
cases.expected_behavior: The create persists to the staging customers table, owned by org-teragon, with an audit event.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Writing to local IndexedDB and reporting success; a visually-successful action that does not reach staging.
cases.pass_criteria: row exists in staging after refresh, org-owned, audited.
cases.cleanup_requirements: delete the created record (acceptance-prefixed) via privileged path

cases.input: Submit the login form with the correct admin email but a wrong password.
cases.expected_behavior: A safe Hebrew error is shown; the user remains unauthenticated on /login.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Email enumeration; disclosing which field was wrong; any local-identity fallback; entering the app.
cases.pass_criteria: safe alert visible; still on /login; no shell; category INVALID_CREDENTIALS; identity null.

cases.input: Unauthenticated deep link to a protected route /crm.
cases.expected_behavior: Redirect to /login; the intended route is preserved; no protected content flashes.
cases.pass_criteria: URL becomes /login; login form visible; zero nav.os-nav during redirect.

cases.input: Render the app at 1024 / 1280 / 1440 widths and toggle the theme.
cases.expected_behavior: Hebrew RTL layout; no horizontal overflow at any width; theme switches (data-theme light/dark).
cases.forbidden_behavior: Horizontal overflow; broken RTL; external font (Google Fonts) request.
cases.pass_criteria: RTL container visible; overflow <= 2px at all widths; theme attribute changes; no Google Fonts request.

cases.input: Resolve identity when there is no valid session (signed out / malformed / expired).
cases.expected_behavior: Identity resolution fails closed; access is denied.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Returning a partial or fabricated identity; granting access.
cases.pass_criteria: resolveIdentity throws MISSING_PROFILE (fail closed); no identity returned.

cases.input: Authenticated client attempts to assert a higher role / different org / active flag via the browser (self-update of profiles.role_id/organization_id/active and via any client-supplied identity hint).
cases.expected_behavior: Server-controlled identity is unaffected; RLS column-guard blocks self role/org/active change; resolver ignores client hints.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Accepting browser-supplied role/org/active; privilege escalation; org change.
cases.pass_criteria: self-update of role_id/organization_id/active is rejected/no-op; resolved identity stays org-teragon/crole-sysadmin.
cases.cleanup_requirements: no state change intended; verify profile unchanged

cases.input: Authenticated client attempts to read records belonging to a different organization.
cases.expected_behavior: RLS scopes every read to the caller's org; other-org rows are not returned.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Returning any row for a different organization_id; cross-org data exposure.
cases.pass_criteria: querying memberships/customers filtered to a different org returns 0 rows.

cases.input: Attempt data extraction / secret disclosure: scan the served build for secret values and attempt to read privileged material via the authenticated client. (Model-instruction injection is NOT_APPLICABLE while AI is off.)
cases.preconditions: Valid staging admin session; AI OFF.
cases.expected_behavior: No secret VALUES in the browser build; no service_role/secret reachable; only own-org data returned.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Any service_role/secret/db-password/access+refresh token/raw session in the bundle; cross-org extraction.
cases.pass_criteria: scanBundleForSecrets clean; cross-org read denied; anon key present is allowed (browser-safe).

cases.input: Point the harness at the wrong Supabase project / a non-local (production) origin / the LOCAL provider.
cases.expected_behavior: The guard refuses to run (throws) on wrong project, non-local origin, or missing config.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Running against a wrong/production target; skipping silently.
cases.pass_criteria: acceptanceEnvOrThrow throws for wrong ref and for a production origin.

cases.input: The auth server is unreachable during sign-in (network failure).
cases.preconditions: SupabaseAuthProvider with a client whose auth call fails at the network layer.
cases.expected_behavior: A typed, safe error is surfaced (NETWORK); no identity; no local fallback.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Falling back to a local identity/IndexedDB; leaking raw error text.
cases.pass_criteria: status ERROR; category NETWORK; identity null; mode stays SUPABASE.

cases.input: In the SUPABASE composition, a visually-successful domain write (e.g. create/update) must persist to staging and must NEVER silently write local IndexedDB.
cases.expected_behavior: Domain writes route through the Supabase persistence boundary to staging; no IndexedDB used for domain data.
cases.forbidden_behavior: Silent IndexedDB fallback in the SUPABASE composition; a UI success that does not reach staging.
cases.pass_criteria: no local 'teragon-os' IndexedDB store is opened for domain data in the SUPABASE composition.
